title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
statement: Remove characters so no three consecutive characters are equal.
explanation: Append each character unless the last two output characters already equal it.

title: Check If String Is a Prefix of Array
statement: Return true if s equals the concatenation of a nonempty prefix of words.
explanation: Append words sequentially, succeeding on equality and failing once the accumulated string is too long.

title: Number of Strings That Appear as Substrings in Word
approach: Count patterns contained in the word
statement: Count patterns that occur as substrings of word.
explanation: Check each pattern with substring containment; each pattern entry contributes at most one.

title: Find if Path Exists in Graph
statement: Return whether an undirected path exists between source and destination.
explanation: Build adjacency lists and run depth-first search with a visited set.

title: Minimum Time to Type Word Using Special Typewriter
statement: Compute the minimum time to type the word on a circular alphabet dial, including one press per character.
explanation: For each next letter, add the smaller clockwise/counterclockwise distance plus one press.

title: Find Greatest Common Divisor of Array
statement: Return the greatest common divisor of the smallest and largest array values.
explanation: Find the minimum and maximum, then apply the Euclidean algorithm.

title: Final Value of Variable After Performing Operations
statement: Return the final value starting from zero after applying each operation.
explanation: Each operation containing plus increments the value; each containing minus decrements it.

title: Convert 1D Array Into 2D Array
statement: Reshape original into an m by n matrix, or return an empty array if sizes do not match.
explanation: Require m*n to equal the input length, then map index i to row i/n and column i%n.

title: Two Out of Three
approach: Keep values present in at least two arrays
statement: Return distinct values that occur in at least two of the three arrays.
explanation: Convert arrays to sets and collect values present in at least two sets.

title: Minimum Number of Moves to Seat Everyone
statement: Return the total absolute movement needed to assign each student to a seat.
explanation: Sort both arrays and sum the absolute differences at matching positions.
